learning_update.intervention: Recomputed the anchored band from the pool minimum and ranked all executed schedules by eligibility then mean gap, reading Best against teacher pIC50.
learning_update.observed_result: Pool minimum 1.902796 Å ([7,5,5,5]); band 1.902796–1.922796 Å; maximum executed condition 1.919852 Å, so all arms are eligible; functional spread inside the band is 0.0819 units. Leader [1,5,7,5] margin to band top 0.00394 Å. Best 7.1537–7.2241 versus teacher 7.412205; valid_best_exceeds_teacher false everywhere.
learning_update.revision: Condition cannot discriminate at these amplitudes, so ranking is entirely by mean gap; the band is an eligibility rule, not a noise floor or an affinity tie tolerance. [7,5,5,5] is the condition leader and functionally last, and no arm can be selected through the Best bonus.
learning_update.next_action: Retain [1,5,7,5] as comparator without a slot; judge every new arm first on ≤1.922796 Å eligibility, then on mean gap, and re-derive the band if a new pool minimum appears.
learning_update.applicability: This teacher/version and the current anchored band; the functional ordering is a fixed-population result and the margin changes whenever the pool minimum shifts.
learning_update.alternative_explanation: Re-anchoring to a different pool minimum or a future condition shift could exclude an arm, changing the ranking by band membership rather than by reinterpreting the gap.
